Package neqsim.process.fielddevelopment.hybrid

Class ScenarioReservoirState

java.lang.Object
neqsim.process.fielddevelopment.hybrid.AbstractReservoirState
neqsim.process.fielddevelopment.hybrid.ScenarioReservoirState
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, ReservoirStateModel
public final class ScenarioReservoirState extends AbstractReservoirState
Reservoir-state proxy that interpolates between several reservoir simulator scenarios.

Each scenario is a ReservoirStateProxy from one simulator run (for example low and high water injection) that also records how a second cumulative volume developed along the run. At the current primary cumulative volume the scenarios are ordered by their value of the second quantity, the two that bracket the current value are selected and every state variable is blended linearly between them:

state = (1 - w) state_low(x) + w state_high(x), w = (y - y_low(x)) / (y_high(x) - y_low(x))

where x is the primary cumulative volume (the abscissa of the tables) and y the secondary one. This makes the proxy a function of two cumulative volumes, for example state = f(Np, Winj), so a strategy that lies between the pre-computed scenarios can be followed without a new simulator run. Outside the envelope of the scenarios the weight is clamped and isOutsideValidity() returns true.
